overview_description.description:
Embark offers dog DNA testing that ends preventable diseases in dogs. It was founded by top experts in genomics, computational biology, and software design to sell an industry-leading dog DNA test. They use a clinical-grade CLIA-certified SNP chip to provide the most accurate and comprehensive results (200,000+ genetic markers) available on the market. 

Their data contributes to proprietary genetics research that will help dog owners optimize nutrition, exercise, allergies, and prevent a variety of heritable conditions. Their technological advantage, intellectual capital, and research-focus enable them to push canine health toward our shared vision of preventative veterinary care.

product.name: Breed + Health Dog DNA Test
product.description: A DNA test that identifies dog breeds, genetic health risks, physical traits, allergy risks, and finds canine relatives.

product.name: Breed ID Dog DNA Test
product.description: A DNA test that decodes a dog's breed mix, ancestry, and identifies canine relatives.

product.name: Dog Age Test
product.description: A DNA test estimating a dog's calendar age and birthday by measuring DNA methylation.

product.name: Veterinarian and Geneticist-Backed Supplements
product.description: Supplements formulated with key ingredients to support various aspects of a dog's health.

product.name: Breeders Dog DNA Test
product.description: A DNA test for adult breeding dogs that screens for breed-relevant genetic health risks and traits, with breeder tools to predict litter outcomes.

product.name: Litter Package
product.description: A testing package for whole litters that provides proof of DNA testing for new puppy buyers along with puppy brochures and DNA health summaries.
